description: Phase-TOOL — tool surface + collection hygiene milestone. 4-scout research 2026-05-22 (docs/research-2026-05-22/{tool-rag-patterns,tool-lifecycle-patterns,aura-tool-surface-audit,tool-collapse-namespace-patterns}.md) + live log analysis surfaced: 29 native tools registered + 18 orphan unregistered Tool types (~1500 LOC dead), 8 duplication clusters (~-2490 LOC removable), tool RAG over-engineering (Qdrant aura_tool_search_v2 at 256d while embed at 768d — recurring dim-mismatch error every 10min), agent thrash on real query (28 LLM calls / 33 tool calls / 180s / never delivered — log 2026-05-22 05:11). User mandate 2026-05-22 verbatim: 'mettere a posto tutti i tool pulire la merda che ci gira attorno. il rag deve auto-aggiornare sui nuovi tool, non hardcoded'. Then update 2026-05-22: 'togli il rag dei tool è una cagata che abbiamo fatto e consolida agli altri pattern. poi metti a posto tutte le collection come abbimao fatto nella memoria'. Locked direction: KILL tool RAG entirely (no replacement), all tools always-on in manifest (picobot/nanobot/openhuman pattern), kitchen-sink collapse for triple-tool duplicates, MCP supervisor with list_changed + circuit breaker + reconnect (Hermes pattern), and dim-mismatch detect for the remaining compact collection. Net LOC delta: ~-4500 cleanup + ~+470 new = net -4000. Plan + acceptance per story: .planning/post-drift-2026-05-21/Phase-TOOL/plan.md. STRICT one-story-exit per scripts/ralph/CLAUDE.md.

userStories.title: KILL tool RAG — delete tool_search + index package + Qdrant collection; all tools always-on in manifest
userStories.description: User mandate 2026-05-22: 'togli il rag dei tool è una cagata'. 4-scout convergence: 0/7 production agent systems use vector embedding for tool routing. picobot/nanobot/openhuman expose flat always-loaded manifests. Aura over-engineered with Qdrant aura_tool_search_v2 + reconciler + drift detection. The whole stack goes. (a) DELETE internal/agent/tools/index/ entirely (reconciler, qdrant adapter, fsnotify watcher, tests). (b) DELETE internal/agent/tools/registry/tool_search.go + its tests. (c) MODIFY cmd/aura/app.go + cmd/aura/app_wire.go to drop reconciler init + tool_search registration. (d) Manual via Qdrant API: DELETE collection aura_tool_search_v2. (e) AUDIT system-prompt manifest token count after Phase-TOOL collapses; assert it stays under 1000 tokens — the always-loaded budget. (f) Boot log emits 'tool registry: N tools active' for ops visibility. NO BM25 replacement, NO new index — picobot pattern is just a flat map[name]Tool that the system prompt iterates. After Phase-TOOL collapses (US-TOOL-05/06/07) the catalog is ~12-15 tools × ~180 char description = ~2700 char ≈ ~700 prompt tokens. Within budget for always-loaded.

userStories.title: MCP supervisor — tools/list_changed listener + per-server circuit breaker + reconnect
userStories.description: Three Hermes patterns folded into one MCP-layer story (all updates apply to the in-memory tool registry — there is no tool RAG to push to after US-TOOL-01). (a) notifications/tools/list_changed listener (mcp_tool.py:1088-1129): when an MCP server pushes a list-changed notification, re-fetch its tools list, diff against in-memory registry, upsert/remove tools so the system-prompt manifest picks them up on the next turn. (b) Per-server circuit breaker (mcp_tool.py:1711-1755): N consecutive failures from one MCP server → server marked unhealthy, its tools temporarily removed from the registry until manual or scheduled retry. Other MCP servers and native tools keep working. (c) Exponential-backoff reconnect (mcp_tool.py:1504-1660): on stdio child crash or HTTP server unreachable, automatic reconnect with backoff.
acceptanceCriteria: Kill an MCP stdio child mid-conversation → next iter, child auto-restarted with backoff; agent doesn't crash
MCP server pushes tools/list_changed → new tool visible in next-turn manifest within 5 sec without restart
3 consecutive failures from server X → circuit opens, logged warning; manifest stops listing server X tools; other tools still callable

Single atomic commit prefix: feat(mcp): supervisor with list_changed + circuit breaker + reconnect (US-TOOL-09)
userStories.notes: DEPENDS ON US-TOOL-01 (no BM25 push — just in-memory registry update) and ideally US-TOOL-08 (override sidecar). LARGEST STORY in the phase.
